## FEATURED PROJECTS

A full-stack marketing and content platform built for a Web3 SaaS startup. Built from scratch without a traditional database, using Astro.js with Git-based MDX routing for optimal performance and zero CMS dependencies.
Result: 12% increase in customer acquisition post-launch.
Stack: Astro.js, MDX, file-based routing
